name: @junctionrelay/shader-rain-window
description: Rain on glass — realistic drops with refraction, trails, fog, temporal persistence, and bloom over a background texture

junctionrelay.description: Rainy glass overlay with temporal persistence and bloom. Drops roll down the surface leaving trails that cut through condensation fog. Wet marks persist and slowly evaporate over ~3 seconds via feedback. Star-pattern bloom adds warm glow to specular highlights.

uniforms.name: rainAmount
uniforms.description: Density of rain — controls settled droplets, large rolling drops, and small fast drops

uniforms.name: fogAmount
uniforms.description: How foggy the glass surface appears — higher values blur the background more

uniforms.name: dropSize
uniforms.description: Scales the radius of all raindrops — lower for fine mist, higher for large heavy drops

uniforms.name: pathVariance
uniforms.description: Controls how erratically drops meander as they fall — 0 is straight down, higher values add lateral wobble and erratic jitter

uniforms.name: windDir
uniforms.description: Wind direction — negative blows left, positive blows right. Tilts background streaks and biases drop drift on glass.

uniforms.name: glassTilt
uniforms.description: Glass surface tilt — negative tilts left, positive tilts right. Drops drift toward the low side under gravity.

uniforms.name: surfaceTension
uniforms.description: How clingy the glass surface is — low values let drops slide quickly, high values make them cling longer and fall slower

uniforms.name: bloomThreshold
uniforms.description: Luminance cutoff — how bright a pixel must be to glow. Lower values bloom more of the image.

uniforms.name: bloomIntensity
uniforms.description: Strength of the additive bloom composite — 0 disables bloom entirely, higher values create stronger glow

uniforms.name: bloomSpread
uniforms.description: How far bloom rays extend from bright spots — higher values create wider, softer glow

uniforms.name: bloomWarmth
uniforms.description: Warm tint on bloom — 0 is neutral white, 1 is warm golden (light through water absorbs blue)
